findings.label: auditor-input-bound
findings.summary: The 160,000-byte auditor brief cannot contain this package and its scoped repository files.
findings.detail: The required package files already total 159,732 bytes before questions.md, references.yaml, approval.md, or any scoped repository file: intent.yaml 15,221 + scenarios.yaml 88,055 + risks.yaml 16,050 + INTENT.md 40,406. Therefore the ordered brief leaves essentially all questions and source files cut. The blind auditor cannot inspect live fixtures, consumers, callers, controller reads, citations, or existing tests while being forbidden to explore the repository, so the claimed checklist observation is infeasible. Raise the bound to cover the complete package plus scoped files, or make omission a blocking failure instead of claiming this audit coverage.

findings.label: evaluation-budget-infeasible
findings.summary: The permitted Shaping and audit budgets exceed the live target's fixed 600-second case budget.
findings.detail: A legal session may spend 5 minutes in the front-loaded window plus a 10-minute autonomous reshape chain, while live-shaping-quality requires every case to finish within 600 seconds. Independently, a first finding can require two 300-second auditor runs on successive revisions, with Jev allowed up to 60 seconds at each stop; this already exceeds 600 seconds before model turns or deterministic work. The hook has no mechanism reserving the case budget, so the required confirming-run/ready observation can time out. Cap the combined session budget (including the initial window), reserve time for Jev and confirmation, or change the case budget; do not rely on relabelling a timeout.
